scope: Feature projection and fold-local preprocessing only; no candidate model, label fitting, calibration or final-test scoring.

numeric_features.name: elapsed_trip_seconds
numeric_features.availability: Snapshot clock minus the departure event already known at that clock.
numeric_features.missing: Required; absence or invalid input stops processing.

numeric_features.name: route_distance_km
numeric_features.source: eta_route_version.planned_distance_km joined by tenant_id and route_version_id
numeric_features.availability: Route known_at <= snapshot_time and valid_from <= snapshot_time < valid_to, with null valid_to open.
numeric_features.missing: Required; absence or invalid input stops processing.

numeric_features.name: remaining_distance_km
numeric_features.availability: Previously computed fictional straight-route projection from valid position known by snapshot time.
numeric_features.missing: Keep null when absent. Mask to null for low_confidence or no_position; do not treat imputed values as measurements.
numeric_features.limitation: Not a road-network distance; bound by planned route distance with 0.001 km rounding tolerance.

numeric_features.name: gnss_speed_kmh
numeric_features.missing: Keep null when absent. Always mask stale speed to null; zero remains a measured zero.

numeric_features.name: position_age_seconds
numeric_features.availability: Exactly snapshot_time minus last_position_time, to 0.000001-second tolerance.
numeric_features.missing: Null only with no_position. Retain stale ages as observation-quality diagnostics; age cannot exceed elapsed trip time.

categorical_features.name: route_id
categorical_features.availability: Same known/valid tenant-scoped route join as route distance.
categorical_features.missing: Required at projection. Previously unseen routes use the transformer's unknown slot without refitting.
categorical_features.limitation: Tenant-local category, not a globally linkable identity or ordinal number.

categorical_features.name: departure_time_bucket
categorical_features.availability: Weekday/hour in the source tenant timezone from the known departure event.
categorical_features.missing: Preserve null. Missing and unseen categories have distinct one-hot slots.

categorical_features.name: position_validity
categorical_features.availability: Position age and source quality available at snapshot time.
categorical_features.missing: Required. Unknown quality is a source-contract error.
categorical_features.stale_rule: age > configured position_stale_seconds is low_confidence; equality remains valid.

excluded_predictor_families: actual_arrival_time, service_start_time, delivery_completed_time and all outcomes
remaining_duration_seconds, delay_outcome, label_eligibility and all target fields
validation simulator truth, scenario IDs and provenance truth
trip, snapshot, vehicle, device and record identifiers
precomputed historical duration references and historical target aggregates
latitude/longitude, optional disabled forecast and routing response fields
promise windows and promise revisions (not part of this initial ETA feature set)
temporal_guards: Require the exact source feature version.
Join route and lineage using tenant-scoped keys; reject mismatches.
Lineage max_source_available_time must not exceed snapshot_time or understate route/position availability.
Validate position source clocks and age before masking stale measurements.
no_position requires absent position clocks, identifiers and numeric signals.
Reject bool, NaN, infinity, negative or malformed numeric inputs.
Upstream source hashes and pipeline joins are separate controls; a lineage timestamp alone is not proof of correct derivation.

preprocessing.scope: Separate serialized state per tenant and chronological fold.
preprocessing.fit_population: All feature opportunities in declared original-training fit trips, strictly before the fold fit cutoff; target eligibility is not consulted.
preprocessing.numeric: Median imputation per feature; all-missing feature uses explicit zero fallback. Center and population standard deviation after imputation; constant scale becomes one. Always emit a missing indicator.
preprocessing.categorical: Sorted training-only vocabulary with separate missing and unknown slots. No validation vocabulary fitting.
preprocessing.weighting: Each fit snapshot contributes equally to preprocessing statistics; later supervised fitting/evaluation must separately declare trip weighting.
preprocessing.validation: Same tenant, no declared fit-trip overlap, snapshots at or after fit cutoff, no refit and no row removal for missing signals or unknown categories.
preprocessing.protected_data: July calibration and August-September test groups are excluded before feature construction and preprocessing fitting.
preprocessing.serialization: Persist feature version, exact ordered feature names, statistics, vocabularies, tenant/fold/cutoff, declared fit-trip keys and fitted snapshot keys; validate on reload.
preprocessing.limitations: Scaling/imputation defaults are engineering choices, not validated accuracy improvements. Candidate-model comparison remains M3b.2-M3b.3.
